tasks.title: Backend hardening: promotion row-lock + CLOSED-member auth + /ready malformed URL
tasks.description:
Three focused robustness fixes from the review backlog. Reuse existing patterns; NO new features; NO money/ledger; all 4 gates must stay green.
(1) PROMOTION ROW-LOCK (backlog #1b): in services/kyc.py get_status/_promote, two concurrent getKycStatus polls on an IN_PROGRESS draft that both see APPROVED could both promote (currently backstopped only by DB uniqueness -> 500). Add a row-level lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE via the repo, e.g. get_by_resume_token_hash_for_update) on the draft before the APPROVED->promote transition, so the second poll serializes and sees the already-APPROVED state (idempotent, 1 Member). Keep the DEC-4 guarantee. Add a test proving concurrent-safe single promotion (simulate by calling the guarded path twice; assert 1 Member, no 500).
(2) CLOSED-MEMBER AUTH (backlog #2, safe subset): get_current_member currently resolves ANY member regardless of status. A CLOSED account must NOT authenticate — make get_current_member reject a CLOSED member (uniform 401, no info leak). ALSO add a reusable `require_active_member` dependency (composes get_current_member; 403 unless membership_status==ACTIVE) for future money/sensitive ops, documented as available but apply it ONLY where clearly correct now (do NOT broadly block PENDING_PAYMENT members from completing onboarding/profile). Tests: CLOSED token -> 401; require_active_member: ACTIVE ok, SUSPENDED/PENDING_PAYMENT -> 403.
(3) /READY MALFORMED URL (backlog #12): a non-empty-but-garbage DATABASE_URL passes engine_configured() then create_engine raises ArgumentError during dependency resolution -> uncaught 500. Catch it so /ready returns 503 db:error (not 500), no exception leak. Test the malformed-URL path.
GATES from backend/ ALL PASS (install any needed dep in your venv): check_models, check_migration, openapi/validate.py, pytest; ruff (E,F) + mypy strict clean on changed files. Handoff: each fix + its test, gate outputs verbatim.

In your worktree git checkout the branch, cd backend, gitignored venv + install deps (PyJWT[crypto], pyotp, cryptography); RUN all 4 gates yourself (paste verdicts) + ruff/mypy on changed files. CHECK: (1) the row-lock actually serializes the promote path (FOR UPDATE on the draft before APPROVED->promote); the concurrent test is NON-VACUOUS (would 500/double-promote without the lock); DEC-4 still holds. (2) get_current_member rejects CLOSED (uniform 401, no leak); require_active_member 403s non-ACTIVE and is NOT applied so broadly it blocks legit PENDING_PAYMENT onboarding completion. (3) /ready malformed URL -> 503 not 500, no exception text leaked. (4) no money/ledger/feature creep; non-negotiables; gates green. Verdict APPROVED/MICRO-FIX/REJECTED with gate verdicts.
